1.Nf3 d5 2.g3 g6 3.Bg2 Bg7 4.O-O e5 5.d3.strategy: Meets the broad Black centre by keeping the structure solid instead of attacking it: the d3 pawn controls e4, frees the c1-bishop and prepares to bring out the queen's knight. White aims for a slow game in which Black's pawn duo has to prove itself.

Develops the knight to a square from which it adds a defender to d5, without blocking the g7-bishop's diagonal or the f-pawn. Both central pawns are backed, and Black is close to castling with a flexible, solid set-up.
1.Nf3 d5 2.g3 g6 3.Bg2 Bg7 4.O-O e5 5.d3.name: King's Indian Attack: Pachman System
